transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

I guess they brought me in. From work... the warehouse. 

People were yelling at me to stop. I was just... moving boxes in these little patterns. And... I don't know, I guess I kept freezing by the forklift. With my arms up. Just copying the beeping sounds and the... the hand signals. 

So they made me come here.
Have you ever felt like you're seeing or hearing things that others don't, or believed something that other people say isn't true?

No... I don't think so. 

I just... hear the normal stuff. Like the machines. I don't really know what other people see.
Have you ever felt like your body was moving on its own or that you couldn't control the way you were moving, like freezing up or acting in strange ways without meaning to?

Yeah... I mean, like I just said. At the warehouse. 

I just... get stuck. By the forklift. My arms just go up and... I copy the sounds. The hand signals. I don't really know if I'm controlling it. It just happens. Same with the boxes... moving them in those patterns. 

They were yelling at me to stop, but... I don't know. I just kept doing it.
Do you ever feel a strong need to repeat certain actions or movements over and over, even if you don’t want to?

I don't know about a need. It's not... I don't feel anything like that. 

I'm not really thinking about wanting to do it, or not wanting to. It just... happens.
Do you ever find yourself making sudden, quick movements or sounds without meaning to—like blinking a lot, shrugging, or blurting out words?
No... not really. I don't... blurt things out or anything like that. Just what I already told you.
Does this kind of thing—where your body moves or acts in ways you don’t control—happen anywhere else besides at the warehouse?
No... I don't think so. Just... just at work.
Has this ever happened anywhere else, like at home or when you're out in public, especially when you're feeling stressed or anxious?
I... no. Like I said, it's just at the warehouse. I don't really notice it at home... or anywhere else.
When these movements happen at work, are you fully aware of what's going on around you, or do you ever feel confused or like you're spacing out during them?
I... no. I know what's happening around me. I don't... space out or anything. I'm just working.
When your body moves in those ways at work, do you ever feel like you're not fully in control of yourself, or like you're not completely aware of what you're doing at the time?
I... I'm aware. I just told you that. I know what I'm doing... it's just... I'm doing my job. I'm in control.
Have you ever had any repetitive movements or behaviors that you feel you must repeat, like tapping, touching things, or counting, especially when you're alone or not at work?
No. I don't... do that. I don't have to count things or tap or whatever. I just... I just go home.
Have you ever noticed any sudden, involuntary movements or sounds when you're not at work, especially during moments of stress or anxiety?
No... I don't do that. I don't make weird sounds or... twitch or anything. When I'm not at work, I just... I just stay home. That's all.
Have you ever had trouble with relationships, work, or other activities because of these movements or behaviors?

I... yeah, I guess. They... they took me off the forklift at work. Said it wasn't safe around me anymore. And... I'm pretty far behind in my classes at the community college. I just... I stopped going to my shifts at the church food bank, too. People just... they tell me they can't count on me. So I just stay home.
Have you ever had any sudden, quick movements or sounds, like blinking, shrugging, or making noises, when you're not at work—even if it's just when you're alone or feeling stressed?
I... no. I don't think so. Like I said before... I don't make noises or... do any of that. I just... I just sit in my room.
Before your body moves in those ways at work, do you ever feel a strange sensation or an urge that makes you feel like you have to do it?
I... no. I don't know what you mean by that. I don't feel any... urge. It's not like that. I just... I don't feel anything before.
When your body starts moving in those ways at work, do you ever feel like you're not fully aware of what you're doing, or like you're watching yourself from the outside?
I... no. I'm awake. I know I'm there. It's just... I'm just there. I don't... watch myself.
When your body starts moving in those ways at work, do you ever feel like you're not fully aware of what you're doing, or like you're in a fog or a dream?
I... no. It's not a dream. I know where I am. I don't... I don't get foggy. I'm just... I'm just working.
Have you ever believed something that others say isn't true, even though you feel certain it is?
I... no. I don't really talk to people about things like that. I don't... I don't know what they think. I just keep to myself.
When your body starts moving in those ways at work, do you ever feel like you're not fully present or like part of you is disconnected from what's happening?
I... no. Like I said, I'm... I'm there. I don't feel disconnected. I'm just... I'm just doing the work. I don't know.
Before your body starts moving in those ways at work, do you ever feel any kind of restlessness, discomfort, or need inside that makes you feel like you have to move?
I... no. I don't think so. I don't feel... restless, or anything. It's not like a need to move. It just... it just happens. I don't feel anything before it does.
When your body starts moving in those ways at work, do you ever feel like your thoughts are not your own or that something outside of you is controlling your actions?
I... no. I don't feel like that. It's just... I'm just there, working. It's my body. Nothing's controlling me. I just... I don't know why it happens.
